title: Policy Engine — tradingMandate schema (AIP v0.8)
description: Standalone JSON Schema for the tradingMandate sub-object of an ObserverDelegationCredential. Useful when authoring policy content before embedding it in a credential and signing. The authoritative on-credential schema for AIP v0.8 credentials is observerprotocol.org/schemas/delegation/v2.1.json; this schema mirrors the tradingMandate sub-tree of that document. The earlier observerprotocol.org/schemas/delegation/v2.json URL remains frozen for credentials issued under AIP v0.7 (e.g. the maxi-0001 demo). See the aip repository SCHEMA_POLICY.md for the immutability policy.

allowedVenues.description: Closed list of venue identifiers the agent MAY transact on. A venue not present is denied.

allowedInstruments.description: Closed list of permitted assets, pairs, or instrument classes.

maxNotionalPerOrder.description: Maximum notional value of any single order, denominated by `unit`.

maxPosition.description: Maximum aggregate open exposure under this mandate, denominated by `unit`.

unit.description: Denomination currency or asset code for maxNotionalPerOrder, maxPosition, and the velocity caps. REQUIRED whenever any of those is present; verifiers MUST NOT infer units.

dailyDrawdownCap.description: Loss ceiling that, if breached, places further action outside the mandate. P&L-based (distinct from velocity volume caps).

allowList.description: Closed list of permitted counterparties. Entries SHOULD be DIDs; raw rail-specific addresses accepted as fallback.

blockList.description: Closed list of denied counterparties. DID or address strings.

requireIssuerClassIn.description: Counterparty's OP-tracked issuer_class MUST be an element of this set. Set semantics, not a numeric tier.

temporal.description: AIP v0.8 — time-of-day window constraint beyond the credential's validUntil.

daysOfWeek.description: Days the window applies. Defaults to all days when absent.

geographic.description: AIP v0.8 — jurisdictional constraints on counterparties. Requires counterparty attestation data carrying jurisdiction.

blockedJurisdictions.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes; counterparty MUST NOT belong to any. Fail-open if jurisdiction unknown.

allowedJurisdictionsOnly.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes; if present, counterparty MUST belong to one of these. Fail-closed if jurisdiction unknown.

velocity.description: AIP v0.8 — aggregate volume velocity caps. Stateful; SHOULD be enforced server-side or by a stateful embedded evaluator. Cap values are denominated by the sibling tradingMandate.unit field.

dailyVolumeCap.description: Maximum aggregate transacted volume in any 24h rolling window.

monthlyVolumeCap.description: Maximum aggregate transacted volume in any 30d rolling window.
